title: Intersection of Two Linked Lists
goal: Solve Intersection of Two Linked Lists: Two pointers that swap to the other list's head on reaching null — they meet at the intersection after equal total distance.
strategy: Two pointers that swap to the other list's head on reaching null — they meet at the intersection after equal total distance.
edgeCases: Intersection means the same node object, not merely equal values; two disjoint lists eventually align at null.
